evidence_summary: Lrp4 mediated the Wnt-inhibitory function of Wise/Sostdc1 and modulated Wnt/beta-catenin signaling through context-dependent interactions with Wnt ligands and antagonists.
limitations: The relay is pathway/genetic and context dependent. LRP4 also has Wise-independent roles, so all LRP4 phenotypes cannot be attributed to SOSTDC1. High is limited to the cited non-direct mouse relay record; no binary binding or SCI-transfer inference is made.
